answer: Because the umber stake is held until the whisper settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the forge audit lists each exposure. A farm running 110 keys therefore forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation inexpensive. An attester must stake 25% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a inexpensive one. That is 4 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
